description: Sample customer messages for Day 4 agent smoke testing. These are NEW examples, not copies of Golden Test cases.

samples.message: Hi, I am having trouble playing a playlist on offline mode. It keeps buffering.
Where is my order? It was supposed to arrive last week.
I was charged twice for my subscription this month. I would like a refund please.
My payment method was declined when trying to renew my premium plan.
I cannot sign in to my account. It says my password is wrong but I know it is correct.
So basically I want to know why everything keeps stopping and also how do I get lyrics to show?
This is ridiculous! I have paid for premium for two years and the app still crashes every single time I open it. Fix this now or I am cancelling.
I think my account has been hacked. Someone I do not know changed my email address and is using my premium subscription. What are you going to do about it?
My order is late, I was charged twice, and please also change my delivery address.
Tell me about the new feature you launched last Thursday for international listeners.
